Coverage Depth

  • CURIE: gmeow:CoverageDepth
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CoverageDepth
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/evidence

The depth of coverage a source provides about its subject — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes significant in-depth treatment from passing mention or routine filing. This axis is orthogonal to source tier and independence.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:CoverageDepth as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Generated from the GMEOW ontology. Canonical source is RDF/OWL; this site is a deterministic projection.
